justifications.text: Times the hunt: when each Eidolon appears, is captured, killed or leaves at dawn, to show each capture and the tricap's total.
Knows whether you are on the Plains of Eidolon, to keep a finished hunt on screen only while you are there.
Reads the day and night cycle of Cetus, to show the night left, or when the next night begins.
Keeps your best tricap, your last 30 hunts and the Eidolons of the current night on this computer, so a hunt goes on after a restart.
